extracted text: The paper discusses AA6082-T6 aluminum alloy thin plates (3mm thickness). The base metal (unwelded) has the following mechanical properties: Yield stress of 289 MPa, Ultimate Tensile Strength (UTS) of 334 MPa, and elongation of 7.5%. The microhardness of the AA6082 in the T6 solution heat treated and artificially aged temper is 105 HV.
property mapping:
